utterances.speaker: ILEANA
utterances.text: And that was kind of the idea, right? But poor countries like ours have to find tools to improve in this area. So we started this project, and I had to research, okay, how could the University of Costa Rica begin to measure and see the impact the university was having, in terms of its research projects, its students, its professors, its publications, and especially the engagement, which was very important.
